offer.name: Name
offer.password.hidden: Hidden. Ferret keeps it in memory until you answer.
offer.password.shown: Shown until you hide it or answer.
offer.update_history: The old password stays under Previous passwords on the item. Nothing else changes.
offer.never.private: You are in a private window. Ferret keeps "Never for this site" only until the browser closes.
offer.master: Ferret never asks for your master password inside a web page.
offer.choose.hint: Which saved login is this password for? Ferret does not pick one for you.
offer.domain.info: These saved logins are for another address of the same site, so Ferret does not update them by itself. Pick one to update it.
offer.reuse.title: This password is also used for:
offer.none: Ferret already has this login saved. Nothing to do.
offer.never_done: Ferret will not offer to save passwords for {host}. You can change this in the settings.
offer.never_done_private: Ferret will not offer to save passwords for {host} until the browser closes.
offer.notice.title: The last attempt to fill this page did not work:
offer.error.not_offered: This offer is gone. It may have run out of time, or the vault was locked.
offer.error.item_changed: The saved login changed in the meantime. Check the card and try again.
offer.error.not_found: That saved login is not in the vault any more.
offer.error.not_a_target: That saved login cannot take a new password from this page.
offer.error.not_updatable: That saved login has fields Ferret cannot keep safely, so it did not change it. Use the web vault.
offer.error.origin_changed: The page changed, so nothing was saved. Submit the form again.
offer.error.invalid_input: Ferret could not use what is on the card. Check the fields.
offer.error.busy: Ferret is already saving this. Wait a moment.
offer.error.vault_locked: The vault is locked. Unlock it to answer the offer.
offer.error.sync_not_running: The sync has not started, so the vault is not ready. Lock and unlock to try again.
offer.error.worker_failed: Ferret's vault stopped while it worked. Unlock it again.
offer.error.read_only: That saved login was made by a newer Ferret and cannot be changed here.
offer.error.unknown: That did not work. Nothing was saved.
